name: Guardian Advance's stomp reaches the client with its stance mask cleared (#6475)
contract: Advance (Damage) 500673 carries Stances 0x30000 (Battle and Defensive Stance) in Spell.dbc. The server clears it
for its own cast check (AscensionGuardianCompletion.cpp ApplyContracts) and must stream the same row to the
client, whose own stance check otherwise refuses the recast before any packet is sent. Expected: the login spell
patch stream includes 500673 and its ShapeshiftMask dword is 0. The harness cannot observe the client-side

steps.label: Let the login patch stream finish
The client received a Spell row for the stomp
